name: docdec
purpose: Answers questions only from your documents: finds the passage, copies the answer word for word with its offsets, and refuses what no passage supports.

lane.accepts: a question about the documents in its index
lane.refuses: questions its indexed documents do not cover

interface.in: {"question":"<text>"} to ask; an answer record {source,start,end,text} to audit
interface.out: an answer record with its source and character offsets, or a refusal naming the check that stopped it

judge.what: an answer record is right when its words are exactly the cited passage's characters at its offsets (claim C6)

inLane.question: Who used the church to unify themselves?

outOfLane.question: What is the best pizza topping?
